headline: Nvidia reinstates its legendary CEO and sees its share price soar 25%
summary: Nvidia's stock rose roughly 25% on Monday, 23 November, after Jensen Huang regained control of the company eleven days after his removal on 12 November 2026. The reinstatement followed revelations about his private life and national security suspicions.
why: Nvidia is the world's largest maker of AI accelerator chips, so its share price moves influence the broader technology sector and AI-linked indices.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The leadership reversal triggered a sharp rally in the company's shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO, reported in the candidates, coincided with a sharp share price rally after a prior sell-off in the technology sector.
original_headline: Nvidia réinstalle son mythique PDG et voir son cours boursier s’envoler de 25%
